autoRespawn.comment: Only respawn interactive sessions with ≥20 conversation turns. Background sessions (<20 turns) terminate permanently on process death.

stability.comment: Session name is immutable after creation (except by explicit user action). Respawns use the same name as source.

autoNaming.comment: Auto-derive name at session creation, then freeze it. User can override once, then it stays locked.

respawnTransparency.eventFormat: [Session respawn] jobId: {jobId}, name: '{name}', prior sessionId: {sessionId:short}, new pid: {pid}
respawnTransparency.comment: Make respawn events visible to user in logs and transcript
